flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui App.tsx (empty COURT block), pages/Report (Court Application Submit Reports placeholder); ocmsadminapi api-authorization.properties (/v1/courtcase without a controller), crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase. No court application confirmation screen
note: The story asks for a confirmation screen showing the reviewed notices list and a count summary, with the options to confirm or return to the review screen. No screen, route, button or API exists for it. The story depends on OCMS22.4 (proceed action), which also has no code. No relevant maintenance ticket. The 'Fully paid' status is not backed by code in the six repos.
recommendation: Do not claim as done based on the code in these six repos. Ask URA/the team in which repo the confirmation screen was built, or mark as a gap

steps.step: OCMS displays the reviewed notices list on the confirmation screen
steps.detail: There is no court application route or page in ocmsadminui: the '{/* COURT */}' block is empty (App.tsx:313) and the system block only holds parameter, standardcode, computer-rule-code, suspension-reason, schedule-public-holiday (App.tsx:375-500). There is no confirmation screen; 'Court Application Submit Reports' is only a label with the resource commented out (ActionReport.tsx:43-49).

steps.step: OCMS displays a summary of the number of notices
steps.detail: There is no summary count component for court application notices (ActionReport.tsx:43-49; Report/index.tsx:65-68 placeholder path "").

steps.step: Officer confirms to proceed with court application
steps.detail: There is no confirm button in the UI and no API to receive the confirmation. The path /v1/courtcase is listed in api-authorization.properties:23,32,41,51 but there is no courtcase or courtcasesummary controller in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi or thirdpartyapi (grep 0 results); OcmsCourtCaseRepository only has findByNoticeNo (OcmsCourtCaseRepository.java:19-21). Checked with the synonyms court application, court batch, courtapp, shortlist, eligible court, weekly across the six repos (UI and API).

steps.step: Officer can return to the previous screen to continue reviewing notices
steps.detail: There is no court application review screen to return to (App.tsx:313 is empty; the court history grid is read-only and its tab is commented out, History.tsx:71-100,170-172). The 'return' action itself does not exist because the confirmation screen does not exist.
